observations.says: in August, the later will was dated the third of March
in August, the later will gave a silver watch to Thomas Pym and spoke of Thomas Pym as christened
on the first of July, Thomas Pym was christened
in August, the later will gave a silver watch to Thomas Pym and spoke of Thomas Pym as christened; on the second of May, Miss Harriet Pym died; on the first of July, Thomas Pym was christened

three years before, the earlier will gave Ashcombe House to Mrs. Grice and the rest of the estate to the church; in August, the later will revoked the earlier will and gave all she had to Mr. Lionel Pym
from the sixth of May until August, Mrs. Grice was at Frome
from the second of May until August, Mr. Lionel Pym had the keys of Ashcombe House
in August, the later will revoked the earlier will and gave all she had to Mr. Lionel Pym
in August, the later will was in a hand very like the hand of Miss Harriet Pym
